correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation gives strict convexity, monotonic decrease in pressure, and a unique density stationary point, yielding the projected closed-form rectangle minimizer. The entropy excess, two-corner reduction, identric crossover, and affine-gauge dependence follow by exact algebra. A standalone deterministic artifact checks the formulas and representative rectangles.

originality.rationale: The motivating 2026 preprint states continuous minimization over the density-pressure rectangle and implements a four-corner comparison, but does not state the exact continuous minimizer, the interior-minimum counterexample family, the two-corner/identric crossover, or the additive-entropy-normalization dependence. Older literature supplies the underlying Euler entropy theory and normalization freedom. Searches found no inspected prior correction of this ELCD construction. Originality is only to the best of our knowledge.

value.rationale: The result corrects a concrete optimization claim in a newly proposed numerical method, gives an exact constant-cost solution to the stated subproblem, and identifies a normalization-dependence issue in the implemented raw-entropy selector. It also cleanly separates continuous rectangle minimization from the discrete corner heuristic without claiming the published numerical experiments are invalid.
